prompt: Is bicuspid valve the same as aortic valve the same thing
judge_reasoning: Candidate 1 gives the correct overall relationship: the aortic valve is normally tricuspid, and a “bicuspid” form typically refers to a bicuspid *aortic* valve (a variant), so they are not the exact same thing. Candidates 2 and 3 make major errors by treating “bicuspid valve” as basically synonymous with the aortic valve and incorrectly suggesting the aortic valve is typically two-cusped. Candidate 4 correctly notes that “bicuspid valve” can refer to the mitral (bicuspid) valve (therefore not the same as the aortic valve), but it contains clear anatomical location errors and doesn’t address the likely “bicuspid aortic valve” interpretation.
